scientific_question: Does a conservative DRRQR reduction of every Qwen3.6-27B GDN Q/K head from Dk128 to Dk112 preserve quality under a fresh frozen baseline and produce a repeat-separated serving benefit on four Ascend 910B4 NPUs?
claim_target: no-material-regression-observed plus repeat-separated performance benefit; lossless-proven is not claimed unless exact equality is established by the frozen contract

paper.title: The Key to State Reduction in Linear Attention: A Rank-based Perspective

forbidden: unrelated containers, processes, ports and files
resource_boundaries.preflight_observation: All NPU0-7 were empty on 2026-09-07; this does not expand authority beyond NPU4-7.
resource_boundaries.release_requirement: Exact experiment containers exited, port8226 closed, host NPU4-7 empty

treatment.candidate: official Strong RRQR channel selection, linear_key_head_dim=112
treatment.reason: Dk64 (50%) and Dk96 (25%) failed the prior GSM8K gate; Dk112 is the next 16-channel-aligned conservative point.
treatment.recovery_finetuning: excluded from this zero-shot identity; any LoRA recovery is a new treatment and experiment

calibration.claim_boundary: The frozen calibration is the documented LongBench-v2 adaptation, not FineWeb-Edu. Reuse changes only pruning ratio and avoids a second uncontrolled calibration change.

execution_order: materialize and structurally audit Dk112 checkpoint
real-weight Dk112 smoke and mechanism activation
fresh baseline quality: LongBench-v2 and GSM8K, three repetitions each
Dk112 quality: identical datasets and repetitions
stop if any quality gate fails
fresh baseline and Dk112 performance, three repetitions each
profile both arms only if quality passes and a performance candidate remains

quality_contract.gate: For each dataset, baseline mean minus treatment mean must not exceed the fresh baseline three-run range.

performance_contract.gate: Output throughput mean must improve and duration mean must decrease; a validated benefit additionally requires non-overlapping complete three-run ranges in the beneficial direction.

stop_conditions: any unexpected NPU4-7 or port8226 owner
checkpoint structural or real-weight smoke failure
any quality dataset crosses its fresh baseline variability boundary
OOM, partial result set or artifact hash mismatch
next_if_rejected: Do not try another zero-shot ratio opportunistically. Open a separately preregistered LoRA-recovery experiment with non-evaluation training data, or conclude that the measurable zero-shot operating point is below the current end-to-end serving noise floor.
